newsitem.title: USA: Sigma Circuit to take $1.5 mln Q3 charge.
newsitem.headline: Sigma Circuit to take $1.5 mln Q3 charge.

text.p: Sigma Circuits Inc said Monday it would take a one-time charge of $1.5 million in its fiscal third quarter, begun January 1.
The Santa Clara, Calif.-based maker of electronic interconnect products also said it expects third quarter sales to be comparable to the second quarter's $20 million.
The charge is related to receivables, inventory and other costs associated with one customer, Sigma said.
The charge represents Sigma's full exposure to that customer, since the extent of recovery is unknown, the company added.
It has filed a lawsuit against the customer seeking full restitution.
Sigma will report its third-quarter results on April 17.
